messages.subject: Error while loading RMongo library
parts:
I am trying with 

REvalOnStartup "library(RMongo)"

RMongo uses java drivers to connect to mongodb, If I get this working, I will be able to connect to mongo db for data storage

I get the following message in apache logs.

Loading required package: rJava
Loading required package: RUnit
Error occurred during initialization of VM
Could not reserve enough space for code cache

Regards
Santosh

messages.author: faa5427c06a1e034
messages.subject: Re: Error while loading RMongo library
parts:
I solved this issue on CentOS 6 by issuing the command:
setsebool httpd_execmem=1 

Regards
Santosh
